name: Shrum Mound
summary: Shrum Mound is a Native American conical burial mound in Campbell Memorial Park in Columbus, Ohio, built by people of the Adena culture roughly 2,000 years ago. It is one of the last surviving ancient mounds within the city of Columbus. The mound was entered on the National Register of Historic Places on November 10, 1970, under the official listing name "Campbell Mound."
